method: Three completed headless AGY research topics with observed search_web queries, independently checked primary sources and baseline repository evidence. Design/adoption retries used public-web-only scope and independent code review. No raw thinking, conversation/project IDs, private configuration or internal source paths are published. Response hashes identify the locally retained public final responses; they are not claims that stochastic reruns yield identical text.
